links.comparator_used: Network trained on the largest database and tested directly out-of-distribution on the smaller databases, without fine-tuning
links.outcome: Balanced accuracy for MER classification (STN detection) on new-centre databases
links.effect: Out-of-distribution testing reduced balanced accuracy by 6.5% to 16.0%; fine-tuning on the new database ameliorated this reduction (no per-model numbers given in the abstract)
links.quote: This reduction can be ameliorated through fine-tuning the network on the new database through transfer learning.

design_hint: local fine-tuning/recalibration on new-centre data before deployment
